notes: New: the ROS builder. Show › ROS Builder… (⇧⌘N) builds a running order right in StandBy when nobody else needs the Sheet: the template's header, departments and columns, start and end times and section totals worked out as you type, Enter for the next cue (numbered for you), row colours, and StandBy's checks as you go. Save it on the Mac (Documents › StandBy Shows), Load into Caller, start from any past show, export a CSV in the template's layout, or print it.
